tensor.matching_equation: n=2(m+b k); n,m,k integers; b irrational implies k=0, n=2m
tensor.circle_map: z -> z^2 with z=exp(-i*pi*q/c), at first-factor phase a=1
tensor.interpretation: Finite integer-lattice window and exact degree-two circle character. General first-factor phase rotates the target circle. Positive surviving action is theta_s(w)=exp(2*pi*i*s/c)w.
